nodes.summary: For a nonnegative discrete spectrum with eigenvalues $E_0 \le E_1 \le \cdots$ and a real number $\Lambda$, the counting function $N(\Lambda)$ is the number of indices $j \in \mathbb{N}$ with $E_j < \Lambda$, so eigenvalues are counted with multiplicity.
nodes.title: Eigenvalue counting function

nodes.summary: For an open set $\Omega \subseteq \mathbb{R}^n$, the volume $|\Omega|$ is the Lebesgue measure of $\Omega$ taken as a real number, with $|\Omega| = 0$ when the Lebesgue measure of $\Omega$ is infinite.
nodes.title: Volume of a domain

nodes.summary: If two nonnegative discrete spectra $S$ and $T$ have the same $j$-th eigenvalue for every index $j \in \mathbb{N}$, then $S = T$.
nodes.title: A nonnegative discrete spectrum is determined by its eigenvalues

nodes.summary: A nonnegative discrete spectrum $S = (S_j)_{j \ge 0}$ is the Dirichlet spectrum of an open set $\Omega \subseteq \mathbb{R}^n$ when $S_j = \lambda_j(\Omega)$ for every $j \ge 0$, where $\lambda_j(\Omega)$ is the variational eigenvalue of $\Omega$ at index $j$.
nodes.title: Dirichlet spectrum of an open set

nodes.summary: For a nonnegative discrete spectrum with eigenvalues $E_0 \le E_1 \le \cdots$, a real number $\Lambda$ and an index $j \in \mathbb{N}$, the index $j$ lies in the finite strict sublevel set at $\Lambda$ if and only if $E_j < \Lambda$.
nodes.title: Membership in the finite strict sublevel set

nodes.summary: For every open set $\Omega \subseteq \mathbb{R}^n$ and every natural number $j$, the Neumann Pólya benchmark of $\Omega$ at index $j + 1$ equals the Pólya eigenvalue benchmark of $\Omega$ at index $j$.
nodes.title: Neumann and Dirichlet Pólya benchmarks agree after an index shift

nodes.summary: For an open set $\Omega \subseteq \mathbb{R}^n$ and a natural number $j$, the Neumann Pólya benchmark of $\Omega$ at index $j$ is the real number $(2\pi)^2 \left(j / (\omega_n |\Omega|)\right)^{2/n}$, where $\omega_n$ is the volume of the unit ball of $\mathbb{R}^n$, $|\Omega|$ is the volume of $\Omega$, the power is the real power with exponent $2/n$, and a quotient by $0$ is read as $0$.
nodes.title: Neumann Pólya benchmark

nodes.summary: A nonnegative discrete spectrum is a sequence of real numbers $E_0, E_1, E_2, \ldots$, the eigenvalues listed with multiplicity, such that $E_j \ge 0$ for every $j$, $E_i \le E_j$ whenever $i \le j$, and $E_j \to +\infty$ as $j \to \infty$.
nodes.title: Nonnegative discrete spectrum

nodes.summary: For an open set $\Omega \subseteq \mathbb{R}^n$ and an index $j \ge 0$, the Pólya benchmark at index $j$ is
nodes.title: Pólya eigenvalue benchmark

nodes.summary: For a smooth test function $f$ on an open set $\Omega \subseteq \mathbb{R}^n$, the Rayleigh quotient of $f$ is
nodes.title: Rayleigh quotient

nodes.summary: For a nonnegative discrete spectrum with eigenvalues $E_0 \le E_1 \le \cdots$ and every real number $\Lambda$, the Riesz mean of order $0$ at $\Lambda$ equals the counting function at $\Lambda$, viewed as a real number: $R_0(\Lambda) = N(\Lambda)$.
nodes.title: The Riesz mean of order zero is the counting function

nodes.summary: For a nonnegative discrete spectrum with eigenvalues $E_0 \le E_1 \le \cdots$ and real numbers $\sigma$ and $\Lambda$, the Riesz mean of order $\sigma$ at $\Lambda$ is the finite sum $R_\sigma(\Lambda) = \sum_{j \in \mathbb{N},\, E_j < \Lambda} (\Lambda - E_j)^\sigma$ over indices, where $x^\sigma$ is the real power.
nodes.title: Riesz mean

nodes.summary: For an open set $\Omega \subseteq \mathbb{R}^n$, the semiclassical counting coefficient is $\omega_n |\Omega| / (2\pi)^n$, where $\omega_n$ is the volume of the unit ball in $\mathbb{R}^n$ and $|\Omega|$ is the Lebesgue measure of $\Omega$ taken as a real number, with $|\Omega| = 0$ when that measure is infinite.
nodes.title: Semiclassical counting coefficient

nodes.summary: For an open set $\Omega \subseteq \mathbb{R}^n$, the space of smooth test functions on $\Omega$ is the real vector space of infinitely differentiable functions $f : \mathbb{R}^n \to \mathbb{R}$ whose support is compact and contained in $\Omega$.
nodes.title: Smooth test functions

nodes.summary: For a nonnegative discrete spectrum with eigenvalues $E_0 \le E_1 \le \cdots$ and a real number $\Lambda$, the finite strict sublevel set at $\Lambda$ is the strict sublevel set $\{j \in \mathbb{N} : E_j < \Lambda\}$, regarded as a finite set of indices; it is finite because $E_j \to +\infty$.
nodes.title: Finite strict sublevel set

nodes.summary: For a nonnegative discrete spectrum with eigenvalues $E_0 \le E_1 \le \cdots$ and every real number $\Lambda$, the strict sublevel set $\{j \in \mathbb{N} : E_j < \Lambda\}$ is finite.
nodes.title: Strict sublevel sets are finite

nodes.summary: For a nonnegative discrete spectrum with eigenvalues $E_0 \le E_1 \le \cdots$ and a real number $\Lambda$, the strict sublevel set at $\Lambda$ is the set of indices $\{j \in \mathbb{N} : E_j < \Lambda\}$.
nodes.title: Strict sublevel set

nodes.summary: For $n \ge 0$, $\omega_n$ is the Lebesgue measure of the open unit ball $\{x \in \mathbb{R}^n : |x| < 1\}$ of Euclidean space $\mathbb{R}^n$, as a real number.
nodes.title: Volume of the unit ball

nodes.summary: For an open set $\Omega \subseteq \mathbb{R}^n$ and an index $j \ge 0$, the variational eigenvalue of $\Omega$ at index $j$ is the Courant–Fischer min–max value
nodes.title: Variational eigenvalue

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
